stage1.impression: A clean, consistent high-key set: eight identical frames, the tints read true and the red, orange, blue and violet throw a convincing coloured pool on the floor. But the white seamless is a featureless void at 249-250 with no horizon, almost no contact shadow and no floor reflection, so the speaker floats; the water-clear and black frames are visibly weaker (the clear horn dissolves into the white, the black cabinet goes to a dense grey block with no edge light). It reads as very good product CG, not yet an Apple launch hero.

blocking_9: A grounded floor: a dense contact shadow under the plinth (lum_p5 under the foot below 120 in every frame) and a visible faint reflection, so the speaker has weight
A tonal separation between floor and wall (a soft gradient of at least 8 levels from the floor at the foot to the wall above the horn) instead of one flat 250 field
The water-clear frame holding its silhouette: every vertical edge and the horn outline drawn by a dark refracted flag line
The black frame lit from behind so its interior and edges read (cabinet interior median above 70, crush under 2%), matching the other seven in presence
No frame weaker than the rest: the coloured floor pool present in all eight, including clear and black

defects.what: water-clear: the horn and the cabinet's top edges vanish into the white background; only thin greenish edge lines hold the shape
water-clear: no pool, no shadow, no reflection on the floor; the speaker floats
black: cabinet reads as a dense grey block, median 47 with 6% crushed; no back-light glow, no edge highlights on the cabinet verticals
black: no visible floor pool or reflection; only a thin dark line at the foot
an unexplained darker band down the left edge of every frame (239.7 vs 249.2 across the rest), an asymmetric fall-off with no matching right side
floor and wall are the same 250 white with no horizon or gradient; the speaker stands in a void
contact shadow under the plinth is a hairline; no occlusion spreading onto the floor
water-clear: the white woofer surround ring is the brightest, highest-contrast element in the frame and pulls the eye from the horn
contact-sheet seams clip at 255 (5.7% clip in that strip); not an issue for the finals but the sheet itself shows hard white gutters

changes.problem: The speaker has no weight: the contact shadow is a hairline and the floor directly beside the plinth is as bright as open floor.

evidence.measured: floor under the foot lum_median 240, p5 226; open floor 250; no occlusion gradient

change.setting: overhead scrim size/height and floor material
change.from: large soft overhead scrim, floor same white as wall
change.to: reduce the overhead scrim to about half its area and raise it 0.5 m so it casts a defined soft shadow; give the floor a slightly lower albedo (about 0.80 vs the wall's 0.90) so the plinth's occlusion reads

changes.expected: a soft dark band 10-25 px deep beneath the plinth in every frame, darkest at the foot

changes.problem: Floor and wall merge into one flat 250 field, so there is no depth and no place for the product to stand.

evidence.measured: wall 249.2 at top, floor 250.1 at bottom; lum_range under 2 in each

change.to: let the seamless fall off by about 10 levels from the floor to the top of frame (light the floor and lower wall, flag the top 30% of the wall), keeping the floor near 248

changes.expected: a gentle vertical gradient: floor ~248, wall above the horn ~236

changes.problem: The water-clear frame loses its silhouette against white; there is nothing dark for its edges to refract.

evidence.measured: horn region visually almost the background value; edges only thin green lines

change.setting: black flags refracted in the vertical edges
change.from: flags at current width and distance
change.to: widen the two side flags and add a third high flag behind and above the horn so a dark line runs down every vertical edge and along the horn's outline; same rig for all eight

changes.expected: clear horn and cabinet edges drawn by continuous dark lines; edge step of at least 80 levels across the cabinet's left vertical in the clear frame

changes.problem: The black frame is a dense grey block with crushed interior and no glow; it is the weakest of the eight.

change.setting: small lamp high behind aimed through the cabinet
change.to: raise its power about 1.5 stops (keep the rig identical for all eight; the bright tints will gain glow too, check they do not clip) or add a second rim lamp low behind the cabinet

changes.expected: black interior lifts to a smoky grey with readable parts, edges catch light

changes.problem: The coloured floor pool, the set's signature, is absent in the clear and black frames and faint in green and yellow.

evidence.measured: clear floor beside foot 250.9 flat; red pool r251 g238 is the only clearly tinted one

change.setting: lamp behind aimed through the cabinet (pool) and floor reflection
change.from: pool only from tinted shadow rays
change.to: aim the back lamp lower so its pool falls 20-40 cm in front of the plinth and add a faint floor reflection (gloss about 0.1-0.15 roughness, reflectance 5%) so even clear and black show a mirrored base

changes.expected: every frame shows a pool or reflection below the plinth; red floor r-g gap grows above 20

changes.problem: An unexplained darker strip runs down the left edge of every frame, asymmetric and reading like an unlit cyc edge.

change.from: seamless edge or falloff visible at frame left
change.to: widen the seamless or add a matching fill so the left and right edges of the frame are within 2 levels (or make the fall-off symmetric as a deliberate vignette)

changes.expected: left and right edge strips equal in value

changes.problem: The speaker fills most of the frame height with tight headroom, leaving no room for a launch headline above it in a 2560 x 1440 hero.

evidence.measured: product spans about y 90-505 of a 592 px panel (70% of height)

change.to: pull back (or lower the product in frame) so the speaker occupies about 55-60% of the height with the extra space above the horn for type; keep the framing identical in all eight

changes.expected: clear negative space above the horn for a headline

changes.problem: The highlights on the horn's top and the white surround in the clear frame clip hard.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 2.44 in the clear frame's woofer area

change.to: apply a filmic shoulder (or pull highlights by about 1/3 stop in post) so specular cores hold detail; leave the background at 248-250

out_of_scope.request: Darken or tint the water-clear version's white woofer surround
out_of_scope.why: it is a part of the speaker and fixed; handle its dominance with light (c3, c8) only

out_of_scope.request: A slightly denser tint for the black and clear sheets
